onboarding.tufIntro.title: About TUF
onboarding.tufIntro.home.title: What is TUF?
onboarding.tufIntro.home.description: TUF (The Universal Forums) is a community-driven organization that collects, rates, and organizes custom levels for A Dance of Fire and Ice. On TUF, players can share their clears, discover new levels, and connect with fellow enthusiasts.
onboarding.tufIntro.levels.title: Browse and download levels
onboarding.tufIntro.levels.description: Browse levels uploaded by creators, find one you like, and download its files to play in ADOFAI.
onboarding.tufIntro.levels.alt: TUF Levels, sorted by likes with Q levels enabled
onboarding.tufIntro.difficulty.title: TUF difficulty system
onboarding.tufIntro.difficulty.descripti: TUF rates levels using its own difficulty system.
onboarding.tufIntro.difficulty.hint: Choose a label to see what it means.
onboarding.tufIntro.difficulty.P.name: Planetary
onboarding.tufIntro.difficulty.G.name: Galactic
onboarding.tufIntro.difficulty.U.name: Universal
onboarding.tufIntro.difficulty.P.descrip: The first 20 ratings in the main scale. A larger number means a harder level.
onboarding.tufIntro.difficulty.G.descrip: The next 20 ratings, above P20. G1 through G20 increase in difficulty.
onboarding.tufIntro.difficulty.U.descrip: The highest tier of the main scale, above G20. U1 through U20 increase in difficulty.
onboarding.tufIntro.difficulty.quantumDe: Quantum estimates a level’s difficulty within a range, before a full rating. It is not a tier above Universal.
onboarding.tufIntro.difficulty.quantumHi: A clear can lead to a more precise G or U rating.
onboarding.tufIntro.difficulty.P0.name: Below P1
onboarding.tufIntro.difficulty.Qq.name: Unknown
onboarding.tufIntro.difficulty.Qq.descri: A level whose difficulty cannot currently be estimated, including some highly technical levels.
A level that has not yet been evaluated.
Issues prevent a rating. See the level’s Full Info comments for the reason.
onboarding.tufIntro.difficulty.Impossibl: A level considered impossible under normal gameplay.
onboarding.tufIntro.scores.title: Clear submissions and scoring
onboarding.tufIntro.scores.description: Submitted clears contribute to your score and position on the leaderboard.
onboarding.tufIntro.scores.caption: Score ranking as of Oct 24, 2026
onboarding.tufIntro.scores.clear.title: Clear score
onboarding.tufIntro.scores.clear.descrip: Level difficulty, absolute accuracy, and playback speed determine each clear’s score.
onboarding.tufIntro.scores.best.title: Best score per level
onboarding.tufIntro.scores.best.descript: Only your highest-scoring clear of each level counts. Repeated clears do not stack.
onboarding.tufIntro.scores.ranked.title: Ranked score
onboarding.tufIntro.scores.ranked.descri: Up to your top 20 eligible scores from different levels contribute, with higher scores weighted more.

onboarding.recommend.jrp.description: The community-standard overlay setup for ADOFAI. Features a key viewer and overlay text during gameplay.
onboarding.recommend.jrp.note: Requires JALib, a dependency mod that allows JipperResourcePack to function and automatically update. JALib is installed automatically.
onboarding.recommend.chatter.description: Reduces keyboard chatter and allows you to configure which keys can input in-game.
onboarding.recommend.chatter.note: The chatter threshold is set to 35 ms. With JRP installed, key limiting is enabled and follows your key viewer bindings. Ghost keys stay unchanged.
onboarding.recommend.tuf.title: TUF, in-game
onboarding.recommend.tuf.subtitle: Choose an in-game interface or a lightweight browser connection.
onboarding.recommend.tufLite.description: Open TUF levels directly from your browser, without an in-game UI.
onboarding.recommend.tuf.description: Browse TUF in-game with a dedicated interface and overlay.
onboarding.recommend.tuf.note: Level Info, Leaderboard, and Score & Speed are enabled automatically. With JRP installed, overlapping overlay elements are turned off.
onboarding.recommend.more.title: More mods
onboarding.recommend.more.subtitle: These mods are optional. Install what you need, then continue.
onboarding.recommend.countdown.descripti: Adds a metronome countdown and lets you start playing on your first input.
onboarding.recommend.countdown.note: Enables beta updates. First-input start is unavailable at the beginning of a chart.
onboarding.recommend.calibration.descrip: Suggests more accurate offsets from your gameplay, with additional calibration tools.
onboarding.recommend.youtube.description: Required by charts that stream their audio from YouTube.
onboarding.recommend.effects.description: Removes visual effects and events to make charts easier to read.
onboarding.recommend.pacl.description: Extends the editor. Required to open some custom levels.
onboarding.recommend.dependency: JALib is installed alongside this mod.
